notes.title: 🚧 Open Steam Playtest Now Live! 🚧
notes.notes: [p]Hello everyone \\o/ [/p][p]After a period of hard work, you can now access the [b]Holder of Place playtest[/b] on the Steam store page! The playtest will be live until [b]October 10th[/b]. [/p][p]In this playtest we mainly want to gather some feedback on our first origin follower (used to be called "Faction"). We've been working on it for a reeeaally long time, and it's quite different from all updates we had done before. So please let us know you feel about it! [/p][p]Click on the "Request Access" button on the game's store page, and you will instantly join the playtest [b]anytime when you see this post [/b]— until October 10th when this playtest ends! [/p][p] [/p][h3][b]New Content in this playtest[/b] [/h3][p][i](New content in this playtest will only show up if you have beat the dragon at least once, although the playtest will use the same save file as the demo)[/i][/p][list][*][p]Added [b]Origin Follower[/b] (used to be called "Faction") - [b]Fate's Beloved[/b]. They'll show up in the first recruit event, and recruiting them as your first follower will as your first follower will replace all normal support followers with a new type of follower: Moth![/p][/*][*][p]Added [b]a very special (and mysterious) event[/b] - a strange machine that, seemingly, can let you wish for a perfect card...? You'll encounter this event in every run as long as you have more than 1 core health.[/p][/*][/list][p]We are also bringing some regular updates to the build. [/p][h3][b]General Updates[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Other than Fate's Beloved, Moths and new cards from the special event, there is also 1 new hollow follower & 1 new endless mode elite[/p][/*][*][p]Changed "a Camp Amidst a Ruin" event (unlock reroll) to always show up between the first and second hunt, as long as you have killed the dragon once. Also lowered the trinket cost from 14 faith to 10.[/p][/*][*][p]The game will now remember your combat speed setting[/p][/*][*][p]Made some small adjustments to some early game card's spawn weighting.[/p][/*][*][p]Witch's golem will now deal their attack damage (instead of 1 damage) to the witch on death.[/p][/*][*][p]Witch in endless mode will no longer protect herself from random damage.[/p][/*][*][p]False sun in endless mode will now scale their stats 90% slower. [/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]If you have any feedback (or want to suggest some new moths), please chat with us in our [url="https://discord.gg/eHeMPfwxAT"][i][b]Discord[/b][/i][/url] or post your thoughts on [i][b]Steam Forum[/b][/i]! [/p][p]Hope you enjoy the game! We appreciate your support. This means a lot to us :3[/p]

notes.title: Demo Update, Localization & Mac Build
notes.notes: [p]Happy Summer \\o/ Thank you so much for playing our demo! Hope you enjoy it as much as we enjoy making it. We have received tons of feedbacks and suggestions, and here's a patch that addresses some of them! We will continue working hard to improve the game, so please look forward to it :D[/p][list][*][p]Added 3x speed option[/p][/*][*][p]Added new audio tracks![/p][/*][*][p]Added 1 new trinket in Endless Mode[/p][/*][*][p]Maze in Endless Mode will now only move a follower to the front-most or back-most position[/p][/*][*][p]Archivist reworked: "Whenever an aspect or trinket is used on a follower, give them +1/+2 permanently"[/p][/*][*][p]Added an option menu! With it, you can now change the volume of background music and sound effect separately or change display mode and resolution.[/p][/*][*][p]Added some new character portraits[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug that caused the game to freeze when more than 50 followers are present[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Casual Looper not working with several followers[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed recruit events during the Dragon fight not spawning as many followers as they should[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Herald always triggering Raven as if only 1 faith is gained[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Artificered Sculptor not working correctly[/p][/*][/list][p]If you have more thoughts or just want to chat about the game, join our [url="https://discord.gg/P6HkcS7Wdk"]Discord[/url] and share your insights with us! [/p][h2]Localization [/h2][p]Meanwhile we've finished implementing the localization framework, and the game is now playable in Simplified Chinese. We will continue to add more languages as we get closer to release.[/p][h2]Mac Support (...?)[/h2][p]We've managed to port the game to MacOS, and you should be able to download and play the demo on your Mac device. However, the game hasn't been notarized through Apple yet, and we are not sure if this will cause any issues. Please let us know if you encounter anything. [/p][p]If for whatever reason we must go through the notarization process to release a Mac version on Steam, then unfortunately we probably won't be able to do it. In that case, Mac support may be postponed or simply might not happen at all :([/p][h2]Looking Ahead[/h2][p]Also here are some teasers for what we are working on for the full release! We still have a lot of exciting features and content going on in the pipeline, please look forward to what's coming! [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45627327/549000e5718ead41e6a7fc1266aa466242881feb.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45627327/c9a1d0767dcefb29df0f07c469a69202fb3aa040.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Holder of Place Demo Available Now!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone, 

After over 3 years of varying stages of development and player feedback on itch.io we’re thrilled to finally arrive on Steam. We are also welcomed by a co-publishing partner Alibi Games and have an expanded demo for you to play right now! 

Holder of Place is an atmospheric roguelike auto-battler set in a long dead kingdom. Recruit followers to fight for you, arrange them for optimal synergies and watch the battle unfold. Along the way, you will experience a dark science-fantasy tale of a ruined kingdom, meet strange characters, visit exotic locations and discover powerful relics. 

[b]Holder of Place features:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fast paced auto-battler gameplay  
[*] Explore the ruins of a dark science-fantasy world 
[*] Challenge yourself in the ever-changing Reliquary Mode 
[*] More features and updates yet to come 
[/list] 
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3732730/Holder_of_Place_Demo/]Check out our demo[/url] and make sure to join our [url=https://discord.gg/eHeMPfwxAT]Discord [/url]channel and share your runs!
